reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The maxbufs c_int owns a cache budget, -1 for unlimited or a rounded positive block count from ch_setbufspace; it owns no existing cache node.
owner_creation.invariant: Cache budget is policy rather than allocated capacity.
limitations: maxbufs is a cache budget rather than the number of allocated nodes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ch_get compares copied budget with active nbufs; lowering maxbufs neither retires cached pointers nor changes the lifetime of retained nonseekable data.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Budget changes do not invalidate cache nodes safely.
limitations: The comparison requires a coherent maxbufs, nbufs and active-file view.

callback_targets.analysis: Budget exhaustion selects whether to call ch_addbuf or reuse an old node; neither branch is a callback retained in the maxbufs scalar.
callback_targets.invariant: Allocation policy does not store callable addresses.
limitations: The ch_get comparison gates direct ch_addbuf, not a callback stored in policy.

invalidation.analysis: maxbufs applies across selected files; it does not brand a retained allocation or initialize that file state’s node list.
invalidation.invariant: A global budget is not proof of per-file allocation extent.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_setbufspace rounds size_t then narrows into c_int and clamps below one; this maxbufs policy commit is separate from allocation/list publication.
mutation_commit.invariant: Budget conversion does not commit a buffer owner.
limitations: maxbufs is policy, not allocated extent; the concern is an incoherent policy/nbufs/active-file snapshot, not allocation ownership inside c_int.

release_pair.analysis: Changing maxbufs never calls free; cache lists are retired by ch_delbufs or permanent ifile disposal.
release_pair.invariant: Budget retirement and storage retirement remain separate.
limitations: Changing the budget does not itself free cache nodes.

error_cleanup.analysis: ch_addbuf failure may disable autobuf and set an empty-cache failure latch; maxbufs neither owns nor rolls back those states.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure handling cannot be inferred from budget alone.

signals_handoff.analysis: A reentrant reader of maxbufs and thisfile counters has no joint configuration/owner snapshot, which is the scoped M0-MEM-001 concern.
signals_handoff.invariant: Coupled cache policy remains a raw-core review constraint.
limitations: Only budget/state coupling is reviewed; no unsupported claim of a runtime integer failure or cache-size defect.
